title: Proofmesh runtime observations 0.3
description: Observed counts per endpoint, table or channel, and observed entity property reads per endpoint, over a time window (A30). A person converts their own capture to this file; Proofmesh reads no vendor format and connects to no service.

source.description: Where the numbers came from, such as the metrics system and query.

repository.description: Optional: the repository name or id the counts belong to; refused if it names another.

name.description: The symbol's qualified name, such as `GET api/Orders/{id}`, `sales.Clients` or `kafka:orders.placed`.

property_reads.description: Entity properties observed read while serving an endpoint, from an instrumented run: the input for moving a full entity fetch to a projection. `entity` is the runtime type of the instance; `declaring_type` the type that declares the property when it differs. `reads` counts requests that read the property; `calls` counts getter calls. `read_kind` separates reads the ORM makes while materialising or tracking (`orm`, loaded but not necessarily used) from reads by application code (`application`). Absence from this list is not evidence that nothing reads a property.

endpoint.description: The endpoint qualified name, such as `GET api/Orders/{id}`.

entity.description: The entity qualified name as the snapshot names it, such as `Shop.Data.Order`.

property.description: The property name on the entity.

reads.description: How many requests read the property in the window.

read_kind.description: Who read it: the ORM while loading or tracking, or application code.

declaring_type.description: The type that declares the property, when it is not the runtime type (inherited or table-per-hierarchy properties).

calls.description: Getter calls in the window, when counted separately from requests.

callers.description: Up to twenty qualified names of the methods that read the property.
